release_notes: Prerelease from https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2 (source PR remains open). Requires explicit library names or IDs, resolved case-insensitively with surrounding whitespace trimmed on every run; recreated libraries with the same name use their new ID. Removes All libraries and prevents empty, missing or ambiguous selections from continuing. Uses streamed catalogue tuples and bounded caches instead of repeated Django model construction and episode identity cleaning. Live measurements: complete 627,500-row catalogue processing improved from 95 to 61 seconds; selected real-media Emby libraries fetched in 2.5 seconds instead of 48 seconds for all libraries. Retains complete-catalogue cleanup, SQLite bulk writes, ownership checks, edited NFO protection, supervised deadlines/cancellation, settings help and scheduled snapshots. Validation: 294 local tests passed with three Windows platform skips; publisher and package checks passed.
